hero.title: AI Job Match
hero.subtitle: Resume in. Apply, maybe, or skip.
hero.tagline: A FastAPI backend for a job-match Chrome extension. It reads a resume file, finds skills with a keyword list, and scores that list against the text of a job page.
hero.impact: Three routes do the work: /upload-resume parses the file, /match-job returns the decision, and /analyze sends the posting to Gemini.

embed.label: Preview
embed.title: The extension panel, in the page.
embed.body: Same layout and colors as the Chrome side panel. Score uses the same skill list and the same 70 / 50 cutoffs, with no API. Analyze ranks skills from the posting text in the browser. Gemini, PDF, and DOCX stay in the backend.

problems.t: A posting is a wall of text
problems.d: The extension has a page, not a structured job object. The API has to pull skills out of whatever text the tab contains.
PDF, DOCX, and TXT need one text string before any score can run.

problems.t: A yes or no, not a paragraph
problems.d: The extension needs a decision it can color: apply, maybe, or do not apply, plus the skills behind that number.

problems.t: A second read of the posting
problems.d: Keyword overlap does not rank which skills matter more. A separate route sends the posting text to a chat model.

layers.title: POST /upload-resume
layers.desc: pdfplumber for PDF, python-docx for DOCX, plain decode for TXT. Then a skill list and a years-of-experience regex.

layers.title: POST /match-job
layers.desc: Skills from the resume, plus any skills the user typed, compared with skills found in the page text.
70 or above is APPLY. 50 to 69 is MAYBE APPLY. Below that is DO NOT APPLY. The score is posting skills the resume covers, divided by the posting skill list.

layers.title: POST /analyze
layers.desc: Sends the posting to Gemini and returns skills in priority order, then a short list of non-skill expectations.

highlights: POST /upload-resume accepts PDF, DOCX, and TXT
Keyword skill list with whole-word matching
POST /match-job returns both scores, matched skills, and a color
Manual skills are merged with skills found in the resume
vercel.json routes every path to main.py
